R1.description: Every namespace-safe shard of a local run starts inside an isolated PID namespace, with a setting for the strictness and a noticed fallback (#329); a full local run wraps no shard until the follow-up (D9(d))

R2.description: A stray kill(-1) in a test is shown to reach only the namespace, the interrupt and leak-scan behaviour is pinned (D6, D7), and the namespace-unsafe modules (D8 included) (modules whose tests fail or skip under the namespace) are read from a wrapped and an unwrapped full run and their shards run unwrapped (D9)

R3.description: The pages and the item record the setting, the limits (D6-D9, the coverage shift, the unwrapped shards) and the two open owner decisions
